title: Downtown Austin MetroRail Groundbreaking
summary:
*   Austin officials will attend the groundbreaking ceremony for the new Downtown MetroRail Station.
*   This event marks the official start of construction for the city's new transit hub.
*   No legislative actions, policy decisions, or public hearings are scheduled for this event.
transcript:
AUSTIN CITY COUNCIL 
 
COUNCIL DISCUSSION 
MONDAY, MARCH 25, 2019 
METRORAIL STATION  
209 E. 4TH STREET 
AUSTIN, TEXAS 78701 
 
Groundbreaking Ceremony

Attend  the groundbreaking ceremony of the all-new Downtown MetroRail Station.
